end.summary:
Practised factorising 6x + 9 by taking out the common factor 3.
Practised finding two numbers using product and sum, then checking by expansion.
Correctly expanded (x − 3)(x + 2) to x² − x − 6.
Repeatedly used coefficients directly as bracket numbers for x² + 5x + 6; this remained uncorrected after the last occurrence.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised taking out a common factor and finding number pairs from the product and sum. They used expansion to verify that (x − 3)(x + 2) gives x² − x − 6. The mix-up of copying coefficients into the brackets came up again and was not corrected after the final occurrence. At home, ask them to check each pair by both multiplying and adding the two numbers before writing the brackets.
